description: This file contains abstract test cases for verifying that command classes in the Eclipse Ditto project, particularly those annotated with JsonParsableCommand, are correctly registered, annotated, and available within the classpath. It uses class indexing to ensure command coverage and supports extension through subclasses.

classes.name: GlobalCommandRegistryTestCases
classes.description: An abstract JUnit test class providing test cases to verify proper registration, annotation, and classpath inclusion of command classes with specific annotations in the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the list of JSON parsable commands by scanning the classpath for classes annotated with @JsonParsableCommand, excluding 'TestCommand'.

methods.name: isExcluded
methods.description: Determines whether a class should be excluded from certain tests; by default, classes starting with 'Dummy' are excluded.

methods.name: sampleCheckForCommandFromEachModule
methods.description: Verifies that all commands that need to be deserialized are included in the classpath samples.

methods.name: ensureSamplesAreComplete
methods.description: Ensures that the sample list contains at least one command from each package of annotated classes.

methods.name: getPackagesDistinct
methods.description: Helper method to obtain a set of distinct packages from a collection of classes.

methods.name: allCommandsRegistered
methods.description: Checks that all non-abstract, non-interface subclasses of Command are annotated with @JsonParsableCommand.

methods.name: allRegisteredCommandsContainAMethodToParseFromJson
methods.description: Verifies that each JSON parsable command class contains a method to parse from JSON as specified by its annotation.

methods.name: assertAnnotationIsValid
methods.description: Helper to assert that a command class has the correct method for parsing JSON, based on its annotation.
